scope: Only QA diagnostic images and this JSON created. No active PNG, approved source, config, importer, game state or document changed.
coordinate_system: Native1024x1536; image-left/right, not subject anatomical left/right. Centroid precision is arithmetic; anatomical reading uncertainty approximately1px.

method.render: Current head then nose01/eyesXX/browsXX/mouth01 on warm background, with or without current hair_back09 before head and hair_front09 after features.
method.pupil_centroids: MeanRGB darkness weights max(100-gray,0), ROIs half-open left[454,363,471,373],right[560,363,577,373]. Same ROIs for all3; thresholds80/120 cross-check changed midpoint <.2px except raw y weights.
method.brow_centroids: MeanRGB darkness max(145-gray,0)*alpha/255 for alpha>=128; image-left ROI[415,325,500,358], right[530,325,615,358]. Core bbox/area use alpha>=200 and meanRGB<145; this excludes faint stray hairs. These are pigment distributions, not rigid landmarks.
method.nose_lip: MeanRGB dark-weight150 in left nostril[497,437,513,453], right[521,437,538,453],lip[477,470,557,484]. Darkness center is an axis proxy and may differ from exact anatomical construction.
method.head_axis: Alpha230 full outer span midpoints at y300/350/365/400/425 are512.5/513/512.5/513/513. Fixed upper head+ear frame is approximatelyx513. Do not use neck base x514.5 as a new face axis.

axis_proxies.meaning: All3 eye pair centers are~1.8-2.4px image-right of head frame; nose/lip pigment centers are~3.5-4.1px right. The features do not share one exact axis; a single blanket shift cannot remove these inter-part offsets.

01.observation: Right brow peak/tail higher and main body longer. Right pigment centroid1.57px higher. Inner ends differ in opacity/taper.

04.observation: Left main body is longer and thinner toward tail; right inner/body region is fuller/darker locally. Left middle/outer body has abrupt step/vertical block in enlarged view. Do not claim right total area is larger: it is not under this core threshold.

05.observation: Right main pigment body has~18% more core pixels and is longer; outer ends on both sides have short upright stubs. Different inner/outer slope and weight affect perceived tilt.

visual_findings.finding: Without any hair, right opening is rounder/more arched and its outer-half white is more conspicuous; left upper contour is flatter, with a longer/darker outer lash. Old two-column15/14.5 aperture reading did not validate full contour or perceived balance. Right is not simply a bigger iris. Same y368 dark-iris threshold145 run is left22px/right20px, an auxiliary texture reading rather than complete anatomical diameter.
visual_findings.repair: Balance paired eyelid shape, outer-corner height/taper and lower-lid curvature; preserve iris/pupil scale and a natural small difference. Do not keep shrinking right iris or copy the old source asymmetry by default.

visual_findings.finding: Less conspicuous than04; outer lash/inner corner and lower contour are not exact counterparts. Pupil dy~.37px is small; no basis to blame large vertical pupil displacement.
visual_findings.repair: Review paired contour in nohair view, after common-axis correction; do not flatten away the intended narrow male eye style.

visual_findings.finding: Right lower/outer opening is fuller; left inner-half opening flatter. Pupil height difference only~.35px, so a vertical pupil shift alone will not fix the perception.
visual_findings.repair: Paired upper/lower contour review with iris preserved; correct clear imbalance without mirroring.

visual_findings.finding: Foreground strands cover image-left outer eye and part of left brow, increasing the already-present apparent small-left/large-right imbalance. Underlying nohair difference remains. No reason to repair this by enlarging only the covered left eye.
visual_findings.repair: Judge face before hair and then repeat09 occlusion check; keep valid hairstyle occlusion separate from eye drawing.

recommended_order: Use fixed head frame nearx513 and actual face/jaw reference to choose one shared central axis. Correct pair-level position and nose/lip whole-layer position coherently; do not blindly repeat historical all-left5px.

Repair04 paired eye contour and brows04/05 visible hard ends/weight imbalance first. Retain the three distinct brow/eye styles. Use new paired drawing when needed; no pasted mirrored eye and no anisotropic stretch.
Check nohair9brow/eye mixes, hair09 and other foreground styles on the same canvas. Recheck whole lid curve/iris/corners/brow silhouettes, not only two iris-level column gradients or SHA.
limits: This is an independent current-asset diagnosis. It does not authorize installation, define final artist-approved coordinates, or treat approved source asymmetry as a mandatory invariant.
